definitions.explanation: A painting created using water-soluble pigments, or the art form itself.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}、{水彩画|すいさいが}を{習|なら}っていた。
examples.english: I learned watercolor painting as a child.

examples.japanese: {水彩画|すいさいが}は{乾|かわ}きが{早|はや}い。
{風景|ふうけい}を{水彩画|すいさいが}で{描|か}いた。
examples.english: I painted the scenery in watercolor.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}の{美術|びじゅつ}の{時間|じかん}に{水彩画|すいさいが}の{描|か}き{方|かた}を{習|なら}った。
examples.english: I learned how to paint watercolors in art class at school.

examples.japanese: {水彩画|すいさいが}は{色|いろ}を{重|かさ}ねることで{深|ふか}みが{出|で}る。
examples.english: Watercolor paintings gain depth by layering colors.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水彩画|すいさいが}を{描|か}く (to paint a watercolor)
- {水彩画|すいさいが}の{道具|どうぐ} (watercolor supplies)
- {水彩画|すいさいが}{教室|きょうしつ} (watercolor class)
- {水彩|すいさい}{絵|え}の{具|ぐ} (watercolor paints)

CHARACTERISTICS:
{水彩画|すいさいが} is known for:
- {透明感|とうめいかん} (transparency)
- {淡|あわ}い{色合|いろあ}い (soft colors)
- {乾|かわ}きの{速|はや}さ (quick drying)

RELATED ART TERMS:
- {油絵|あぶらえ} (oil painting)
- {日本画|にほんが} (Japanese-style painting)
- {水墨画|すいぼくが} (ink wash painting)
